backlog.spec: In infer's tta(), change _get_tta_logits to use only the original image and its flip (2 views) instead of 6 views (drop crop_tl/crop_br). This cuts predict time; check accuracy loss is small.
backlog.title: Drop TTA to mirror-only on uncertain set

backlog.spec: Set UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE in tta() from 0.25 to 0.15 to reduce TTA compute in predict while keeping most of the accuracy gain.
backlog.title: UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE 0.15

backlog.spec: Not timed compile, so no gain from this; instead try mode='max-autotune-no-cudagraphs' for forward_step and make_model to see if run time changes (cudagraph overhead/memory copies).
backlog.title: Reduce max-autotune to default compile for forward_step

backlog.spec: In _zeropower_via_newtonschulz5 remove the third unrolled iteration (keep 2 NS steps). Saves optimizer time; may need slight MUON_LR change.
backlog.title: Fewer Newton-Schulz iterations (2)

backlog.spec: Run the orthogonalization every step but compute Muon update for the big 256-wide convs only; alternatively apply Muon to all filters every step but use head SGD. Simplest: keep as is except set norm_freq schedule constant at 8 to reduce norm computations (group['norm_freq']=8).
backlog.title: Skip Muon on first conv-only odd steps

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=2048, scale MUON_LR by 1.15 and BIAS_LR/HEAD_LR by 1.1; fewer steps lowers optimizer overhead per epoch.
backlog.title: Larger batch 2048 with scaled LR

backlog.spec: BATCH_SIZE=1024 with MUON_LR scaled by 0.9; more steps may improve accuracy per epoch, allowing EPOCHS reduction to 7.0.
backlog.title: Smaller batch 1024

backlog.spec: Use batch 1024 for the first half of training and 2048 in the second half by changing the loader batch size per epoch (re-slicing indices); keep LR schedule per step.
backlog.title: Batch size ramp

backlog.spec: Add a short linear warmup over the first ~0.3 epochs (step-based factor min(1, (step+1)/warm)) multiplied with the existing linear decay for all optimizers.
backlog.title: Cosine-ish LR tail: decay to zero with warmup

backlog.spec: Replace lr_factor2 = 1 - step/total with (1 - step/total)**1.2 for both optimizers; Muon target magnitude schedule unchanged.
backlog.title: Non-linear decay power 1.2

backlog.spec: Use lr factor max(0, 1 - step/(0.95*total_steps)) so the last 5% steps are at zero LR, saving nothing but test if EPOCHS can be cut; alternatively end schedule at 0 at 92% of steps and stop training early (total steps*0.92).
backlog.title: Decay to nonzero floor then zero

backlog.spec: For the first ~40% of epochs, train on 24x24 random crops (or downscaled 0.75 images via F.interpolate) then switch to full 32x32; the network is fully convolutional with final MaxPool(3), so adjust nothing else. Saves compute early.
backlog.title: Progressive resolution

backlog.spec: Change widths to block1=64, block2=192, block3=256 to cut conv FLOPs; compensate with nothing else. Test time-accuracy tradeoff.
backlog.title: Channels width 64/192/256

backlog.spec: Set widths block1=96 and keep others; first block conv at full resolution cost grows but may raise accuracy.
backlog.title: Wider block1 96

backlog.spec: Move max pool after the norm+activation in ConvGroup (conv->norm->act->pool) for block1 only? Instead simpler: apply activ before pool is equivalent for monotone; skip. Actual change: replace SiLU with GELU in ConvGroup to test faster fused kernel.
backlog.title: Remove first-block second conv pooling order

backlog.spec: LABEL_SMOOTHING=0.12 together with EPOCHS unchanged; test regularization effect.
backlog.title: Label smoothing 0.12

backlog.spec: TRANSLATE=3 (pad 3 reflect) for more augmentation diversity; may help accuracy.
backlog.title: Cutout-free: stronger translate 3

backlog.spec: Set brightness and contrast jitter enabled False in train() aug dict to save kernel time; accuracy may drop slightly.
backlog.title: Disable color jitter

backlog.spec: EPOCHS=7.0, MUON_LR=0.23, HEAD_LR=0.58; shift along the curve with slight lr compensation.
backlog.title: Fewer epochs with higher LR

backlog.spec: MUON_MOMENTUM=0.72 and MUON_LR=0.19.
backlog.title: Muon momentum 0.7 with nesterov off-tuning

backlog.spec: WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS=0.1 so whiten bias grad stops sooner (less backward work and a second compiled graph variant).
backlog.title: Whiten bias epochs 0.1

backlog.spec: In init_whiten call use train_loader.images[:480] instead of 960 to reduce SVD setup time.
backlog.title: Smaller whitening patches count

backlog.spec: In tta(), set first-pass batch B=5000 and tta_batch_size=3000 to cut loop iterations/launch overhead.
backlog.title: Reduce eval batch work: single compiled predict

backlog.spec: Set head param group weight_decay to 0 and HEAD_LR=0.6.
backlog.title: Head LR higher with no weight decay on head

backlog.spec: SGD_MOMENTUM=0.9 with BIAS_LR=0.045 and HEAD_LR=0.45.
backlog.title: Remove SGD momentum on biases tuning

backlog.spec: Replace alternating flip with per-epoch fixed flip but also keep batch_flip_lr pre-flip only; remove the pre-flip pass for epoch 0 by using images directly (saves one pass). Implement by skipping batch_flip_lr and letting alternating flip do all flipping.
backlog.title: EMA-free: flip every epoch random on half

backlog.spec: In Conv.reset_parameters skip dirac_ init for convs where in==out (conv2 layers) to test accuracy effect of default init.
backlog.title: Dirac init off for block2 conv2

backlog.spec: Change BatchNorm default momentum parameter from 0.5566 to 0.45 (running stats less stale at eval).
backlog.title: BatchNorm momentum 0.45

backlog.spec: Change forward's head output scaling from /x.size(-1) to /(x.size(-1)*0.8)... equivalent: multiply logits by 1.25 and reduce HEAD_LR accordingly to 0.45 to test logit scale sensitivity.
backlog.title: Final head scale tweak

backlog.spec: In Muon.step, remove the do_norm_scaling branch (the _foreach_norm, scale_factors and the torch._foreach_mul_(filter_params_with_grad, scale_factors) call) so only the orthogonalized update and weight decay are applied. This removes a per-step norm computation and a host-visible branch. If accuracy drops, raise MUON_LR by 5 percent.
backlog.title: Skip Muon norm scaling entirely

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=1024 and multiply MUON_LR, BIAS_LR and HEAD_LR by about 0.82 (sqrt of 1024/1536). Keep EPOCHS unchanged. More steps per epoch may improve accuracy enough to repay the time lost to lower GPU efficiency.
backlog.title: Batch size 1024 with LR scaled by sqrt

backlog.spec: Replace the 28x28 interpolation (which crashed earlier) with F.interpolate to size (24,24) for step < total_train_steps/3. Use mode='bilinear', antialias=False. Do the interpolation inside the loader on the whole epoch's tensor, once per epoch, to avoid dynamic-shape recompiles. Remove the old 28x28 block first. Cache size limit is already 64, so two input shapes are fine. Note that the max pool(3) at the end must still work: 24 input gives 23 after whiten, 11, 5, 2 and then pool 3 gives 0, so instead use AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1) for the last pool, or use 28 only.
backlog.title: Progressive resolution fixed: 24px first third

backlog.spec: Keep the architecture but compute the first ConvGroup on 2x average-pooled whitened features for the first 30 percent of steps. This is not simple to implement, so alternatively use a random-resized-crop-free change: for step < 0.3*total_train_steps feed 28x28 center-cropped (not interpolated) inputs, inputs[:, :, 2:30, 2:30]. Final MaxPool2d(3) still works (27 whiten, 13, 6, 3, 1).
backlog.title: Lower resolution via channel-last half-res first block

backlog.spec: Set LABEL_SMOOTHING=0.05. Short training with heavy smoothing can underfit, and TTA on confident logits relies on logit scale. Single constant change.
backlog.title: Drop label smoothing to 0.05 with fewer-epoch compensation off

backlog.spec: Set the color_jitter enabled flag to False in train(). This removes the batch_color_jitter kernel launch and its memory traffic on the full dataset each epoch. For a 7-epoch run, little regularization is needed, so accuracy may hold.
backlog.title: Remove color jitter

backlog.spec: Change lr_factor2 and lr_factor1-independent schedule to lr_factor2 = (1 - step*lr_factor2_base)**1.3 for all groups except the whiten bias. A convex decay spends less time at high LR and often gives a better final accuracy in short runs. Muon's internal target magnitude schedule is left untouched.
backlog.title: Tail LR floor with squared decay

backlog.spec: Change widths to block1=48, block2=256, block3=320. Reduces the expensive full-resolution convs in block1 while adding capacity in the cheap 4x4 resolution stage. Check that the Dirac init and Muon padding still work (max_K is derived automatically).
backlog.title: Wider final block, narrower first conv group

backlog.spec: In _get_tta_logits, drop the flipped crop_br view and the flipped crop_tl view, keeping the base, crop_tl, crop_br and the flipped base (4 views), and set UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE to 0.3 to compensate. Less prediction time, in the timed region, with a broader TTA coverage.
backlog.title: Use bfloat-free fused TTA: only 4 views

backlog.spec: Change LABEL_SMOOTHING from 0.09 to 0.12. With a short schedule and a large batch, stronger smoothing may improve generalisation and test accuracy at identical speed. Nothing else changes.
backlog.title: Label smoothing 0.12

backlog.spec: Change TRANSLATE from 2 to 3. The loader reflect-pads by this amount and randomly crops, so the cost stays the same. Test whether more translation diversity raises accuracy. The TTA code uses its own pad=1 and is untouched.
backlog.title: Translate 3 augmentation

backlog.spec: Set widths block1=96 (from 64) while keeping block2=256 and block3=256. Conv1 of block1 runs at reduced resolution after pooling in part of the net, but conv2 of block1 is cheap, and the extra capacity early may gain accuracy that allows fewer epochs. Keep the dirac init as is. Judge by the cost metric.
backlog.title: Wider block1 to 96 channels

backlog.spec: Change the LR factors in the training loop from the linear 1 - step/total to (1 - step/total) ** 1.3 for both lr_factor1 (whiten bias) and lr_factor2. Keep the same final value of zero. Using a bit more decay early may improve final accuracy, which can be traded for time.
backlog.title: Non-linear LR decay power

backlog.spec: Change the BatchNorm default momentum argument from 0.5566 to 0.45 (the class uses 1-momentum as the torch momentum). Faster running-stat adaptation near the end of a short run may improve eval accuracy at no cost.
backlog.title: BatchNorm momentum 0.45

backlog.spec: In the predict tta function set UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.15, which cuts the 6-view inference work on the test set by 40 percent. Accuracy may drop very slightly. Timing includes predict, so this trades a little accuracy for time.
backlog.title: Lower TTA uncertain quantile to 0.15

backlog.spec: Raise HEAD_LR from 0.5415 to 0.7 and lower SGD_MOMENTUM from 0.825 to 0.75. Possibly the head benefits from faster learning in a short schedule. Keep everything else the same.
backlog.title: Head and bias LR re-balance with higher HEAD_LR

backlog.spec: Replace the alternating-epoch flip with a cheaper scheme: drop the images.flip(-1) copy per odd epoch and instead flip the pre-flipped base set in the loader differently each epoch by using the batch_flip_lr kernel on the padded images once per epoch (applied before batch_crop on proc_images['pad']). Aim to remove the extra flip materialisation while keeping flip diversity. Verify accuracy stays equal.
backlog.title: Bolder: 3 epoch-level random flip instead of alternating

incumbent.description: The Muon helper was recompiled every step because the Python int step count is specialised by torch.compile, so I now pass the step as a CUDA tensor and raised the dynamo cache limit as a safeguard.

memo:
Helped: only slot 3, a pure overhead fix (the Muon helper was recompiled every step because the Python int step count was specialised). It scored -0.0396 and -0.0814 over 2 runs, mean_adjusted -0.0543, and is the incumbent. Slot 14 (24x24 first third) scored -0.1194/-0.0779 official, but only -0.0382 vs the incumbent, so it was rejected. It is worth a replicate.

Did not help: model-shrinking changes (block2 192: +0.1186; widths 48/256/320: +0.0594), fewer Muon NS steps (+0.3952), 2-view TTA (+0.1382), constant norm_freq 8 (+0.0335), shorter whitening-bias schedule (+0.0598). Small tweaks (GELU, no color jitter, BN momentum, 480 whitening images, no-cudagraphs, skipping the epoch-0 flip) were all within noise (sd about 0.026) or worse. Slot 2 (28x28) crashed.

Next: hunt for more overhead (graph breaks, other recompiles, host-device syncs, loader and predict cost). Replicate the 24x24 idea. Avoid epoch tweaks and accuracy-affecting model changes.
